project_info.theme: Avant-garde trench fashion held still against a fast-moving city
project_info.color_palette: beige gabardine, iridescent silver PVC, pale blonde, warm gold, muted city gray

main_subject.detail: An adult East Asian woman with a pale-blonde high ponytail, airy see-through bangs, softly refined oval facial contours, large dark-brown eyes, natural translucent makeup, and a quiet gentle half-smile. Her natural skin has visible pores and delicate pink undertones.
main_subject.style: cinematic Japanese or Korean avant-garde street-fashion portrait

items: waist-up centered portrait with the subject standing still and facing camera
one arm bends naturally to hold a small geometric metallic-silver clutch; architectural rings remain visible

deconstructed beige gabardine trench coat reimagined as a dress, with iridescent PVC panels, asymmetrical oversized cut, exaggerated shoulders, cinched waist, exposed zippers, cargo pockets, and flowing straps
a busy metropolitan crossing behind her, with pedestrians and cars rendered as long-exposure motion streaks

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight, approximately 4500K, with soft urban bounce
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: warm sunlight around the pale ponytail and shoulders, calm crisp subject against blurred city movement
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: a poised, healing calm contrasted with frenetic metropolitan energy

technical_specs.render_style: Canon EOS R3, 50mm tilt-shift lens, slow shutter with subject stabilized, vertical waist-up crop
technical_specs.color_treatment: soft glossy finish, restrained warm highlights, realistic skin texture, natural city motion blur

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic vertical waist-up street-fashion photograph of an adult East Asian woman standing still in a busy Tokyo or Seoul metropolitan crossing at late-afternoon golden hour. She has a pale-blonde high ponytail with airy see-through bangs, softly refined oval facial contours, large dark-brown eyes, natural translucent makeup, visible natural skin texture with delicate pink undertones, and a quiet gentle half-smile. She wears an avant-garde deconstructed trench coat reimagined as a dress: structured beige gabardine contrasted with iridescent PVC panels, an asymmetrical oversized cut, exaggerated architectural shoulders, cinched waist, exposed zippers, large cargo pockets, and flowing straps. Add an industrial silver chain choker, bold architectural rings, and a small geometric metallic-silver clutch held in one naturally bent arm. Around her, pedestrians and cars become long-exposure streaks of light and movement while she remains calm and crisp. Use late-afternoon golden-hour light at approximately 4500K with soft urban bounce, warm highlights around her ponytail and shoulders, and a polished documentary street-fashion finish. Canon EOS R3, 50mm tilt-shift lens, slow shutter with the subject stabilized, realistic skin texture, and natural city motion blur.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, gravure, sexual pose, poreless skin, flawless skin, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The optional moodboard preserves the pale-blonde ponytail, deconstructed beige trench dress with PVC panels, silver choker, geometric clutch, waist-up pose, golden-hour city crossing, and moving crowd. An approved-adult face reference may be attached to replace the subject; preserve her face, facial structure, and likeness. The city may be changed while retaining an urban golden-hour setting and the contrast of a still subject against long-exposure movement.
